name: Code Dojo — Daily Coding Practice
description: Duolingo-style discipline for coders: daily streaks, XP, leagues, quests and premium focus sessions (countdown ring, break timer, wake lock) — plus automatic practice tracking on the Odin Project, away-session coverage for VS Code and assignment pages, a daily goal with a stretch ring, on-device lesson quizzes (Chrome's built-in AI, nothing leaves your machine) with strict local grading, wrong answers queued to come back tomorrow, and a "what couldn't you do today?" loop from the big screen's focus room. v1.8: learning notes get an on-device review — four yes/no checks, one specific comment, a suggested rewrite to compare, and points computed by plain code.
